0 grammar ::= remember stmtseq
1 grammar ::= GRAMEXPR optexpr
2 grammar ::= GRAMBLOCK block
3 grammar ::= GRAMBARESTMT barestmt
4 grammar ::= GRAMFULLSTMT fullstmt
5 grammar ::= GRAMSTMTSEQ stmtseq
6 grammar ::= GRAMSUBSIGNATURE subsigguts
7 bare_statement_block ::= block cont
8 bare_statement_expression ::= sideff PERLY_SEMICOLON
9 bare_statement_null ::= PERLY_SEMICOLON
10 bare_statement_utilize ::= KW_USE_or_NO startsub BAREWORD optlistexpr PERLY_SEMICOLON
11 block ::= PERLY_BRACE_OPEN remember stmtseq PERLY_BRACE_CLOSE
12 empty ::=
13 remember ::=
14 stmtseq ::= empty
15 stmtseq ::= stmtseq fullstmt
16 fullstmt ::= barestmt
17 barestmt ::= bare_statement_block
18 barestmt ::= bare_statement_expression
19 barestmt ::= bare_statement_null
20 barestmt ::= bare_statement_utilize
21 sideff ::= expr
22 cont ::= empty
23 startsub ::=
24 attrlist ::= COLONATTR attr attrs
25 attrlist ::= COLONATTR attr attrs COLONATTR
26 attr ::= ATTRLIST
27 attr ::= ATTRLIST PERLY_PAREN_OPEN PERLY_PAREN_CLOSE
28 attr ::= ATTRLIST PERLY_PAREN_OPEN ATTRLIST PERLY_PAREN_CLOSE
29 attrs ::= empty
30 attrs ::= attrs COLONATTR attr
31 attrs ::= attrs attr
32 attrlist ::= COLONATTR
33 optsiglist ::= empty
34 subsigguts ::= optsiglist
35 expr ::= listexpr
36 listexpr ::= listexpr PERLY_COMMA
37 listexpr ::= listexpr PERLY_COMMA term
38 listexpr ::= term
39 termbinop ::= term ASSIGNOP term
40 termbinop ::= term MULOP term
41 termbinop ::= term ADDOP term
42 termbinop ::= termrelop
43 termbinop ::= termeqop
44 termrelop ::= relopchain
45 termrelop ::= term NCRELOP term
46 termrelop ::= term PLUGIN_REL_OP term
47 relopchain ::= term CHRELOP term
48 relopchain ::= relopchain CHRELOP term
49 termeqop ::= eqopchain
50 termeqop ::= term NCEQOP term
51 eqopchain ::= term CHEQOP term
52 eqopchain ::= eqopchain CHEQOP term
53 termunop ::= PERLY_MINUS term
54 termunop ::= PERLY_PLUS term
55 termunop ::= PERLY_EXCLAMATION_MARK term
56 termunop ::= PERLY_TILDE term
57 termunop ::= term POSTINC
58 termunop ::= term POSTDEC
59 termunop ::= PREINC term
60 termunop ::= PREDEC term
61 term ::= termbinop
62 term ::= termunop
63 term ::= myattrterm
64 term ::= scalar
65 term ::= star
66 term ::= hsh
67 term ::= ary
68 term ::= arylen
69 term ::= THING
70 term ::= amper
71 term ::= LOOPEX
72 term ::= LOOPEX term
73 term ::= NOTOP listexpr
74 term ::= UNIOP
75 term ::= UNIOP block
76 term ::= UNIOP term
77 term ::= KW_REQUIRE
78 term ::= KW_REQUIRE term
79 term ::= FUNC0
80 term ::= FUNC0 PERLY_PAREN_OPEN PERLY_PAREN_CLOSE
81 term ::= FUNC0OP
82 term ::= FUNC0OP PERLY_PAREN_OPEN PERLY_PAREN_CLOSE
83 term ::= FUNC1 PERLY_PAREN_OPEN PERLY_PAREN_CLOSE
84 term ::= FUNC1 PERLY_PAREN_OPEN expr PERLY_PAREN_CLOSE
85 term ::= BAREWORD
86 myattrterm ::= KW_MY myterm attrlist
87 myattrterm ::= KW_MY myterm
88 myattrterm ::= KW_MY REFGEN myterm attrlist
89 myattrterm ::= KW_MY REFGEN term
90 myterm ::= PERLY_PAREN_OPEN expr PERLY_PAREN_CLOSE
91 myterm ::= PERLY_PAREN_OPEN PERLY_PAREN_CLOSE
92 myterm ::= scalar
93 myterm ::= hsh
94 myterm ::= ary
95 optlistexpr ::= empty
96 optlistexpr ::= listexpr
97 optexpr ::= empty
98 optexpr ::= expr
99 amper ::= PERLY_AMPERSAND BAREWORD
100 scalar ::= PERLY_DOLLAR
101 ary ::= PERLY_SNAIL
102 hsh ::= PERLY_PERCENT_SIGN
103 arylen ::= DOLSHARP
104 star ::= PERLY_STAR BAREWORD
